impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
        while let Some(Record::GainChangeForTheLaneWithLongName(x))
        | Some(Record::PanChangeForTheLaneWithLongName(x)) = self.peek_next()
        {
            let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
                break;
            };
            self.apply(record);
        }
    }
}
